verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a versioned public API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec (157 paths), interactive references, and scoped service keys intended for scripts and automation. That is a real first-party foundation for custom integrations. However, nothing in the evidence shows endpoints for pushing custom evidence or test results from uncovered systems. missing for 10: documented evidence/test-result ingestion endpoints, a custom-integration guide or examples, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build private/custom integrations against a documented API to push evidence and test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover

citations.quote: Oneleet serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its Public API (157 paths)
Use service keys for AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace.
note you can import the spec into Postman or use it to generate an API client
Grant Full access to all tenant service-key scopes, or choose Limit access to… to grant only specific scopes.
